summary: Verified PWA installability assets (manifest.json, sw.js, icon-192/512.png) all served with correct MIME types + status 200. index.html has manifest link, apple-touch-icon, and title 'LaundryMax POS'. Service Worker registers on load and controls page. Reprint flow works end-to-end in /tracking detail sheet (tracking-reprint-button → receipt-picker-modal → 3 model options → receipt-preview-modal). All three templates (customer/production/bagtag) render correct plain-text via buildReceiptTextLines: customer has 'TOTAL' and '>>> LUNAS <<<'; production shows 'SLIP PRODUKSI' with no 'Rp' prices; bagtag shows 'BAG 1 / 1'. print-bluetooth-button gracefully shows humanized toast 'Browser tidak mendukung Web Bluetooth' in headless Chromium. print-browser-button opens a new print window with no page errors. CustomerHistoryModal in /tracking (via autocomplete → customer row) shows history-reprint-{orderId} button that opens picker correctly. No pageerrors observed. Regression: tracking search, autocomplete, and pagination still working.
critical_code_review_comments: sw.js APP_SHELL caches '/' — if backend index.html changes hash bundle refs, cached shell may serve stale html; consider bumping CACHE_NAME on each deploy or dropping '/' from precache.

bluetoothPrinter.requestPrinter uses acceptAllDevices:true which forces optionalServices matching only after connect; if a printer only exposes a non-standard service, filter list would be safer for UX. Non-blocking.
orderToPrintPayload assumes payment_status === 'Lunas' (capitalized). Backend returns 'Lunas' but any casing drift would silently switch to 'BAYAR SAAT AMBIL'. Consider .toLowerCase() compare.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded order LND-DEMO-1787032696 (Preview Test / 08111 / Rp 15.000 Lunas / Packing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: PWA + reprint feature fully functional. Static assets (manifest, sw, icons) served correctly at root. SW registers + activates. All 3 receipt templates render correctly in preview modal. Web Bluetooth path throws expected humanized toast in headless environments. If retesting BT on real device, need Android Chrome + HTTPS.
